newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech real Oct farm revenues rise 4.8 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Czech real Oct farm revenues rise 4.8 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Total revenues from Czech farming enterprises rose 4.8 percent year-on-year in October, in inflation-adjusted terms, putting revenues for January-October down 0.2 percent, the Czech Statistical Office said on Monday.

The figures refer to the sale of own goods and services in total. Revenues from agricultural production alone were up 4.6 percent year-on-year in October but down one percent in the January-October period.

The Statistical Office added that the number of workers employed in the farm sector fell in absolute terms to 146,550 from 147,501 in September and was 5.1 percent lower than in October 1995. The average monthly farm wage was 8,956 crowns, down from 8,263 in September
